CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LimitLiabilityFund_LNS
AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund
AS(
SELECT
BLL.LIMIT_B2KID AS [LimitId]
,BLL.BANK_ID AS [FinancialInstitutionId]
,BLL.LCHG_TIME AS [Timestamp]
,BLL.LIAB AS [LimitLiabilityAmount]
,BLLD.RECORD_STATUS
,BLL.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
,'LNS' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
FROM BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB_DELTA BLLD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB BLL ON BLL.LIMIT_B2KID = BLLD.LIMIT_B2KID AND BLL.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
[LimitId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[LimitLiabilityAmount]
)) HASHROW, LimitId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),


TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
[LimitId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[LimitLiabilityAmount]
)) HASHROW, LimitId
FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilityFund
),


TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.LimitId, TGT.LimitId) as LimitId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_TGT TGT
ON SRC.LimitId = TGT.LimitId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
[LimitId] = SRC.LimitId
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[Timestamp] = SRC.[Timestamp]
,[LimitLiabilityAmount] = SRC.LimitLiabilityAmount
FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilityFund TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LimitId = TGT.LimitId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund SRC ON SRC.LimitId = TGT.LimitId;


--INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.LimitLiabilityFund
(
[LimitId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[LimitLiabilityAmount]
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,[WORKFLOWID]
,[TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]
)

SELECT
[LimitId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[LimitLiabilityAmount]
,'LNS' AS [SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,0 AS [WORKFLOWID]
,0 AS [TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityFund_DELTA;

END
